title: Care workers to be represented in Fair Pay Agreements
key_claim: The government backs the first adult social care Fair Pay Agreement with £500 million for 2028 to 2029, with negotiations starting April 2027 and the first settlement by April 2028, for a workforce of 1.5 million.
frame_summary: Presents the Fair Pay Agreement as a recruitment and retention reform for 1.5 million carers, with a fixed funding sum and timetable.

title: Fair pay agreement process in adult social care: government response
key_claim: The government will set an annual funding envelope within which unions and employers negotiate; the grant is not ringfenced and local government does not vote on final agreements.
frame_summary: Sets out a process in which central government fixes the money, unions and employers bargain inside it, and councils pay without a vote.
